text:
jordan: Morning — quick async standup. What I did: validated AMS spot capacity, drained 4 nodes for kernel patch, updated capacity dashboard. Blockers: APAC quotas still limited, got a 403 on resource requests from cs-priv. Today: request quota bump for apac-east, coordinate ephemeral pool for canary rollout.
sam: thanks. For the 403 can you paste the request id? I'm willing to triage. Also what's the target cores/gpu type? :mag:
jordan: request id 0a3f7c12, we need 8x A10g or 4x A100 (single-tenant). Pref A10g for cost. I filed a ticket with cloud support — ticket #CLD-8932. Ops-bot: Deploy bot noticed ongoing drain in eu-west-1 causing 12% capacity dip between 03:05-03:20 UTC. No incidents.
lee: FYI the dedicated pool autoscaler didn't pick up pending pods because of nodeSelector mismatch in the canary helm. I pushed a tiny fix to infra/canary values; PR #422 waiting review.
anya: reviewing PR now. Also let's not overlap the drain with the canary — can we shift the canary window by 1 hour?
jordan: yes, canary moved to 08:30 UTC. sam — can you follow up with cloud support for quota bump? we should ask for soft limit increase to 16 A10g in apac-east for 2 weeks.
sam: on it, pinging contact. If they refuse we'll spin burst on gcp-spot with fallback to eu-west.
lee: added a prewarm job to keep minimal KV caches warm during the drain. Might shave ~50ms on cold starts.
anya: blocker: need RBAC approval for the prewarm job in prod namespace — on people's radar?
jordan: pinging security for one-time exemption. ops-bot: Security ticket created: SEC-1284. No action required from oncall yet.
sam: quick ask — any objections to enabling prefix caching on the canary? Should reduce token cost but slightly increase memory.
lee: +1 from infra. Jordan, can you confirm memory headroom in canary pool? We have ~20% free before scaling.
jordan: confirmed. +1 to prefix cache.
anya: LGTM. I'll approve PR after CI passes. I'll also add a short rollback note to the canary runbook.
ops-bot: Canary scheduled 2026-03-17T08:30:00Z (job_id canary-20260317-01). Rolling window 30m.
jordan: sweet. No other blockers from me. I'll post an update after the quota response.
sam: thanks team. I'll update this thread when cloud support replies.
lee: wrapping up - will monitor queue length and prewarm logs. :nerd_face: 
anya: done with review, merging once CI green. :tada: 
jordan: thanks — end of async standup.
